titleEn: Delta Kitchen Renovation Cost 2026: Real BC Project Example
titleZh: 三角洲廚房裝修造價：真實BC省案例與2026最新報價
contentEn:
This Delta kitchen was rebuilt in white shaker cabinetry with a quartz waterfall peninsula and a matching full-height counter run. A deep apron-front sink sits under the window with brushed brass tapware, and a stacked tile backsplash carries the light finish behind the range and hood. Oak-toned plank flooring runs through the space. The same project renewed the bathroom, where a soft grey vanity with a black-framed mirror faces a marble-look tiled tub surround.

For Delta homeowners comparing contractors in 2026, this project illustrates what a full kitchen-and-bath renewal actually costs in the municipality — and why a single coordinated job can outperform two separate cosmetic refreshes.

What Made This Delta Kitchen Renovation Distinct

The client wanted a kitchen that could host family gatherings without feeling dark or dated. The renovation removed a soffit above the stove area, opened the sightline to the dining nook, and daylight from the window above the apron sink now reaches all the way to the back wall. Shaker-profile doors in off-white were specified throughout — the builder matched doorreveal depth to the existing cabinet box so the new fronts sat flush without replacing the carcases. A quartz waterfall peninsula at the island adds a strong material contrast against the white and provides seating for four without a separate table in the galley layout. Brushed brass bin pulls and a gooseneck bridge faucet complete the hardware palette without introducing a finish that shows water spots. The stacked subway tile behind the range is a deliberate continuity move: it extends the same material from the range wall to the window wall so the whole cooking zone reads as a single composed surface rather than a patchwork of product choices.

Full Renovation Cost per Square Foot in Delta, BC — 2026

Full-scope kitchen renovation in Delta (cabinetry replacement, new countertops, plumbing rerouting, electrical rework, flooring, and finishes) ran $180–$280 per square foot of renovation area in early 2026. Cosmetic-only refresh (refacing existing cabinets, new laminate countertop, new fixtures) typically lands at $65–$110 per square foot — lower upfront cost but with limited structural upgrade value. The Delta market sits slightly below Vancouver proper and above the Fraser Valley average for comparable scope.

Bathroom renewal in the same project (vanity replacement, new tub surround, tile work, upgraded lighting, and通风 improvements) added approximately $18,000–$28,000 to the contract — treated as a separate room but managed by the same crew on a coordinated schedule to reduce trip charges and overlap trade prelims.

Project Timeline in Delta

The kitchen phase ran nine working days from demolition to practical completion of the cabinet install. Countertop template occurred on Day 5; countertop install on Day 11. The bathroom phase ran concurrently during the countertop lead time, finishing two days after the kitchen practical completion. Total elapsed from site start to full handover: 13 working days.

Why Coordinate Kitchen and Bath in One Contract

For Delta homeowners on a budget, a combined contract reduces the per-sqft premium on both rooms. The renovator's overhead — site setup, waste disposal, permit coordination — is amortised across two spaces rather than charged twice. Lead times for countertops, plumbing fixtures, and tile are booked in parallel, so the overall schedule is only marginally longer than a single-room job. Reno Stars manages both rooms under one project manager and one permit application, which simplifies inspections and reduces the chance of scope gaps between trades.

If your Delta home needs a kitchen refresh and your bathroom is showing its age, a coordinated quote typically delivers better value than scheduling the rooms separately — particularly when both are on the same floor and share a plumber.

本項目與眾不同之處

客戶希望打造一個能舉辦家庭聚會、又不顯昏暗過時的廚房。工程拆除灶台上方的壁柱，開通至餐區的視線； apron sink上方的窗戶引入的日光現在可直接照射到後牆。啞光白色Shaker門板全屋統一規格——建築商比對門板深度與現有櫃體，使新門板無縫嵌入而不需更換整體框架。石英石瀑布半島的吧台區域提供四人座位，在走廊式格局中無需另行擺放餐桌。拉絲黃銅拉手和鵝頸橋式龍頭完成五金配置，且不引入易留水漬的表面處理。疊砌地鐵磚位於灶台區——同一材料由灶台牆延伸至窗牆，使整個烹飪區形成統一構圖而非零散產品組合。

三角洲BC省全面裝修造價每平方英尺——2026年

2026年初，三角洲全面廚房裝修（櫃體更換、新台面、管道改線、水電改造、地板及飾面）造價為每平方英尺180至280加元。基礎翻新（僅更換門板、新層壓板台面和新五金）通常為每平方英尺65至110加元——前期成本較低但結構升級價值有限。三城市場低於溫哥華市區但高於菲沙谷同類工程平均水平。

同期浴室翻新（浴室櫃更換、新浴缸區、瓷磚工程、照明升級及通風改善）為合同增加約18,000至28,000加元——作為獨立房間計算但由同一團隊協調安排，以減少差旅費用和前期工程重疊。

三角洲工程時間表

廚房階段從拆除至櫃體安裝實際完工共9個工作日。台面量尺在第5個工作日；台面安裝在第11個工作日。浴室階段在等待台面期間同步進行，於廚房實際完工後2天完成。從開工到全面移交總工期：13個工作日。

為何將廚房與浴室納入同一合同

對有預算考慮的三角洲業主而言，合併合同可降低兩個空間的每平方英尺溢價。翻新公司的間接成本——工地設置、廢物處理、許可證協調——分攤至兩個空間而非雙重收費。台面、衛生間五金和瓷磚的交貨周期並行安排，總工期僅略微延長於單房工程。聚星裝修一個項目經理和一份許可證申請管理兩個空間，簡化驗收流程並減少各工種之間的範圍缺口。

若您的三角洲住宅需要廚房翻新且浴室已顯老舊，合併報價通常比分開安排更具性價比——尤其是兩者位於同一層且共用水管的情況。
